    // True when the box is empty (inverted on either axis): no point lies inside.
    IsEmpty(self: Bounds2D): Boolean
        => self.Min.X > self.Max.X || self.Min.Y > self.Max.Y;

    IsEmpty(self: Bounds3D): Boolean
